_comment: Corrections over the archived upstream data, reconciled against Riot patch 18.1 through the August 31 balance update and September 1 bug fixes (18.1d).
The upstream MetaTFT snapshot is stamped PBE, August 16. audit.json records explicit numeric checks, source dates, and remaining uncertainties.
`stats` replace a base stat. Unit `curve` lists begin at 1 star: multiple values replace those stars only; one value makes a row constant.
Adaptor-form stats are independent of base stats and need explicit form overrides when a correction applies to both.
Item `curve` values are constants. Trait `curve` maps address breakpoint columns, not star levels.

Riftbeast column 3 (7 units) uses the published 5% growth correction. Column 4 (10 units) inherits that corrected growth because its tooltip only adds team size; this inheritance is an explicit inference recorded in audit.json.

TFT18_Cinderling._source: Riot patch 18.1, August 31 balance update: Cinderling Ability Damage 340/510/765/1300 ⇒ 310/465/700/1200 — https://teamfighttactics.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/game-updates/teamfight-tactics-patch-18-1/

DA_Riftbeast18._source: Riot patch 18.1, August 31 balance update: Riftbeast (7) AD/AP/AS 6% to 5%. The archived 10-unit tooltip only adds 2 maximum team size, so column 4 is inferred to inherit the corrected 7-unit growth, not restore its stale 6% values. This preserves the simulator's high context, which selects column 4 because its raw style is 4. Direct live confirmation of column 4 is unavailable; see audit.json. https://teamfighttactics.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/game-updates/teamfight-tactics-patch-18-1/
